originalPlotBeatVerbatim.name: Twenty-minute Ankita-led personal presentation
originalPlotBeatVerbatim.plot: The official work presentation is already complete. Ankita jokingly turns the next twenty minutes into 'her own presentation', using confident posture, movement, fashion adjustment, sustained eye contact and bold double-meaning conversation to tease both men. Bhalla and Sandeep both actively reply, compliment and test one another's wit; their individual interpretations stay distinct. Ankita rules the room rather than spending the encounter blushing passively. Suddenly she snaps out of the experiment, brings it to an abrupt close and leaves. Only afterward do her deeper blush, racing warmth and reflective uncertainty register. She is not satisfied because she cannot fully read the men's genuine private reactions. Future seed: the unproven 'am I actually beautiful?' ego challenge makes her want to run another test at a later encounter, without a scheduled promise.
